meta.name: agent-orchestration-advisor
meta.description: Design multi-agent AI workflows with clear boundaries, handoffs, and monitoring. Use when a complex PM task should run as parallel specialized agents instead of one linear process.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 设计多智能体协作流程，明确边界与交接
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在项目中协调多个AI智能体分工合作
copy.tagline_en: Design multi-agent workflows with clear boundaries and handoffs
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to coordinate multiple AI agents in a project

howto.what: Claude 会充当编排顾问:通过提问收集你的重复性 PM 任务,判断是否适合多智能体并行,再拆解成子任务并分配专门代理,产出一个带代理分配的流程设计。
howto.when: 当你要把一个复杂 PM 任务改成并行代理,或描述每周耗时 5 小时以上的重复性研究/整理任务,或需要大规模一致性分析时,Claude 会引导你完成设计流程。

say.text: 帮我设计一个竞品情报的编排:现在一位 PM 每周花 6 小时顺序收集、总结。
say.note: 它会先收集上下文,再判断是否适合编排。

say.text: 我们有一条巨型顺序提示链,帮我重新架构为编排系统。
say.note: 它会拆解任务,设计并行/串联流程。

say.text: 我每周要汇总 100 份用户访谈,给我设计并行代理。
say.note: 它会评估是否适合编排,并拆分代理。

howto.what_en: Claude acts as an orchestration advisor: it asks about your repetitive PM tasks, determines if multi-agent parallelism fits, breaks the work into subtasks, assigns specialized agents, and produces a workflow design with agent assignments.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you want to turn a complex PM task into parallel agents, describe recurring research/synthesis work taking 5+ hours a week, or need consistency at scale.

say_en.text: Design orchestration for competitive intel: PM spends 6h/week sequentially.
say_en.note: It starts by gathering context on your task.

say_en.text: Re-architect our giant sequential prompt chain into an orchestrated system.
say_en.note: It decomposes the task and suggests flow patterns.

say_en.text: Help me design parallel agents to synthesize 100 user interviews weekly.
say_en.note: It evaluates fit and breaks the work into agents.
